room_rent.note: Global Cover (inbuilt) pays room rent at actuals worldwide; India Cover (optional 3.2) room rent per schedule

icu.note: ICU under base In-Patient Treatment; no cap stated

copayment.note: No mandatory base co-pay; Voluntary Co-payment (3.3.2) optional for premium discount; 20% co-pay on Dental cover only

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise capping in base; Modern Treatment limited per schedule

initial_waiting.note: VERIFY: no separate 30-day initial waiting (Excl03) found - exclusions jump Excl02 to Excl04

ped_waiting.note: Excl01; reducible to 24 or 12 months via optional (3.3.3)

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18); no maternity benefit found

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonus 25% of India Base SI/claim-free yr up to 100% (Benefit 3.2.15, India Cover)

restoration.note: Unlimited Reinstatement of India Base SI (3.2.17) 'if applicable' - optional; no inbuilt restore on base

pre_hosp.note: India Cover (3.2.6); Global Cover pre-hosp per schedule

ambulance.note: Global air/road ambulance inbuilt; India road (3.2.2) + air (3.2.3) per schedule

consumables.note: VERIFY: consumables not clearly addressed as separate cover

global_cover.note: Global Cover (3.1) is the flagship inbuilt cover - worldwide treatment; India Cover is the optional add-on (3.2)

grace_period.note: VERIFY: grace period not clearly captured (renewal during grace protects credits)

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity excluded (Excl18); global-first structure (Global Cover inbuilt, India Cover optional); Modern Treatment & India money limits per schedule; Dental cover has 20% co-pay

optional_riders.display: India Cover, Unlimited Reinstatement, Voluntary Co-pay, PED waiting reduction, Inflation Protection, Air Ambulance, Companion/Travel covers
